usage_guide.how_to_use: Instead of loading full file, reference this manifest to load only relevant chunks

benefits: Original files remain intact (no breaking changes)
Backward compatible (can still load full files)
limitations: Requires manual chunk boundary updates if files are heavily edited
Chunk lines are approximate (files may be updated)
Users must reference manifest to know which chunks to load
future_enhancements: Auto-detect chunk boundaries using heading structure
MCP server integration for semantic search
